_readme: EMC x TSC1/TSC2, ROUND 6, 2026-08-24 -- VERIFY THE ONE POSITIVE. The whole measured frequency rests on a single sample, sarcoma_msk_2022-2691, carrying TSC2 Q955*. Before that number is quoted anywhere, two things about that sample should be checked against the record rather than assumed: (a) its full clinical annotation, to confirm the histology call really is Extraskeletal Myxoid Chondrosarcoma and to read whatever else the cohort records about it; (b) whether it carries an NR4A3 structural variant. EMC is DEFINED by NR4A3 rearrangement, and sarcoma_msk_2022 carries a structural-variant profile, so an NR4A3 fusion in this sample would be independent confirmation that the histology label is not a mis-annotation -- and its ABSENCE would be a real caveat on the one data point the frequency depends on. The structural-variant endpoint's GET shape is not known from here, so several are tried; a 404 is information about the API and costs nothing. NR4A3 entrez id is fetched rather than assumed.
